fault_metric_scope: Firecracker process endpoint-ready through artifact return; includes all Firecracker VMAs and is not a guest-RAM-VMA or UFFD-event count

randomization.request_order: one FILE and one UFFD per rate interval; seeded order within each pair; half-interval separation

url_selection: urls[pair_index % len(urls)]; both halves of a pair render the same page
